sentences.en: Hello, everybody, and welcome back to The Psychology of Your 20s, the podcast where we talk through some of the big life changes and transitions of our 20s
sentences.zh: 大家好，欢迎回到《二十多岁的心理学》，在这里我们探讨二十多岁时面临的一些重大生活改变和转折，

sentences.en: and what they mean for our psychology.
sentences.zh: 以及它们对我们心理意味着什么。

sentences.en: Hello, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家好。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the show.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本节目。

sentences.en: Welcome back to the podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 欢迎回到本播客。

sentences.en: New listeners, old listeners, wherever you are in the world, it is so great to have you here as always, back for another episode as we dive into the psychology of our 20s.
sentences.zh: 新听众，老听众，无论你们身在世界的哪个角落，和往常一样，很高兴你们能来收听新的一期节目，和我们一起深入探讨二十多岁的心理学。

sentences.en: So I want to talk about something today that I have been struggling with recently.
sentences.zh: 所以今天我想聊聊一件我最近一直在纠结的事情。

sentences.en: You know, I'm just going to jump straight into the point.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我就直接切入正题了。

sentences.en: I don't know about you, but I have been really experiencing this strange sense of just dissatisfaction towards my life recently, a lingering kind of buzzing sense of exhaustion,
sentences.zh: 我不知道你们怎么样，但我最近确实对生活产生了一种奇怪的不满情绪，一种挥之不去的嗡嗡作响的疲惫感，

sentences.en: an aimlessness, a kind of like a boredom when it comes to my interests, my future, my relationships, my health, my life in general.
sentences.zh: 一种漫无目的的感觉，每当面对我的兴趣、未来、人际关系、健康以及我的整个生活时，就会有一种类似于厌烦的情绪。

sentences.en: It's been really bothering me as someone who is very proactive when it comes to just like actually enjoying my life.
sentences.zh: 这真的很困扰我，因为我本来是一个对待真正享受生活非常积极主动的人。

sentences.en: I like feeling excited about things.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢对事物感到兴奋的感觉。

sentences.en: I like feeling optimistic about the future.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢对未来抱有乐观的态度。

sentences.en: And that just hasn't seemed to be the case recently.
sentences.zh: 但最近情况似乎并非如此。

sentences.en: And I've been really looking into what it might be.
sentences.zh: 我一直在深入探究这究竟是怎么回事。

sentences.en: The biggest thing for me has been low energy, not being able to kind of show up in my friendships as I would like.
sentences.zh: 对我影响最大的是精力不足，无法像自己希望的那样在友谊中展现出好的状态。

sentences.en: I cannot tell you the number of plans
sentences.zh: 我简直数不清有多少次社交安排

sentences.en: I have cancelled in the last three months.
sentences.zh: 是我在过去三个月里取消的。

sentences.en: And I've kind of just reached the conclusion that I have lost my spark a little bit.
sentences.zh: 我基本上得出了一个结论，那就是我有点失去了生活的火花。

sentences.en: I've lost the buzz, the love, the thrill for life.
sentences.zh: 我失去了对生活的热情、爱意和悸动。

sentences.en: And I don't think that I am the only one.
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得我不是唯一的一个。

sentences.en: You know, our 20s come with a lot of expectations that are hard to ignore.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我们二十多岁时伴随着许多难以忽视的期望。

sentences.en: There is so much hype around these being like the best years of your life filled with adventure and sleepless nights and random friendships and relationships
sentences.zh: 外界对这个时期有很多吹捧，说这是你一生中最美好的几年，充满了冒险、不眠之夜、各种偶然的友谊和恋爱关系，

sentences.en: and these warm, brilliant memories you'll get to look back on for years to come.
sentences.zh: 还有那些你在未来几年回想起来会觉得温暖而美好的记忆。

sentences.en: And I think maybe this is what we would define as our spark, like an enthusiasm to go out and grab life and to be interested and interesting
sentences.zh: 我想这或许就是我们所定义的火花吧，就像一种走出去拥抱生活的热情，对事物保持兴趣并且让自己变得有趣，

sentences.en: our spark is the thing that kind of keeps us passionate about showing up in the world and it keeps us passionate about who we are and the experiences that we're having.
sentences.zh: 我们的火花正是那种让我们对在这个世界上展现自我保持热情的动力，它让我们对自己是谁以及正在经历的体验充满热情。

sentences.en: It's what makes us inspired and kind and engaged and motivated and present.
sentences.zh: 正是它让我们受到启发、保持善良、积极参与、充满动力且活在当下。

sentences.en: But we can't be that all the time.
sentences.zh: 但我们不可能无时无刻都保持那样。

sentences.en: You can't really be living in the golden bubble every minute of every day.
sentences.zh: 你不可能真的每时每刻都生活在那个黄金泡泡里。

sentences.en: There will come a time as I guess I'm experiencing right now as we speak where the energy and the excitement for life kind of dips.
sentences.zh: 正如我此刻正在经历的那样，总会有一天，你对生活的精力和热情会有所下降。

sentences.en: You become very detached from that person that you love, that person that you are at your core and everything around you seems to lose a bit of colour.
sentences.zh: 你会变得非常疏离，远离那个你所热爱的、处于你内心核心的自己，你周围的一切似乎都开始失去色彩。

sentences.en: You lose that kind of energy that you bring into conversations, that energy that you bring into your daily life.
sentences.zh: 你失去了那种带入对话中的能量，带入日常生活中的能量。

sentences.en: And for me, I've been really reflecting on this and I've been thinking about the person I was three or four years ago who just seems so in love with life and really wondering
sentences.zh: 对我来说，我一直在反思这一点，我在想三四年前那个似乎对生活无比热爱的自己，并且真的在纳闷

sentences.en: where she's gone, whether I can get her back, but also whether I want her back or whether it's just a general
sentences.zh: 她去哪儿了，我是否能找回她，但同时我也在想，我是真的想找回她，还是这只是一种普遍的

sentences.en: disconnection.
sentences.zh: 断联感。

sentences.en: So we're going to talk about that today.
sentences.zh: 所以我们今天就要聊聊这个。

sentences.en: I want to talk about why we lose our spark, why it is such a common experience, the reasons behind that.
sentences.zh: 我想谈谈为什么我们会失去火花，为什么这是一种如此普遍的经历，以及这背后的原因。

sentences.en: It may be burnout, it may have been a breakup, but then also six tips for regaining that motivation and that love for life.
sentences.zh: 这可能是因为职业倦怠，可能是经历了一次分手，同时也会分享六个重新找回这种动力和对生活热爱的建议。

sentences.en: Losing your spark could be for a number of reasons, but there are four main explanations that I think stand out to me, especially in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 失去火花的原因可能有很多，但我认为有四个主要原因尤为突显，尤其是在我们二十多岁的时候。

sentences.en: The first, the biggest one really is burnout.
sentences.zh: 第一个，也是最主要的一个原因，其实就是职业倦怠。

sentences.en: Pushing ourselves too hard for too long and ignoring the warning signs that we need rest and we need time to actually process our lives, our emotions and all the activity
sentences.zh: 我们对自己逼得太紧、时间太久，忽视了那些我们需要休息、需要时间来真正消化生活、情绪以及所有发生的活动的警告信号，

sentences.en: that is going on.
sentences.zh: 这些活动正在不断发生着。

sentences.en: We're seeing a lot of research that burnout is becoming a lot more common during this day and age, especially amongst people under the age of 30.
sentences.zh: 我们看到大量研究表明，在当今这个时代，职业倦怠变得越来越普遍，尤其是在30岁以下的年轻人当中。

sentences.en: Now, I think the reason for this is twofold.
sentences.zh: 现在，我认为造成这种现象的原因有两个方面。

sentences.en: Number one, we're obviously quite new to the workplace, but also new to life.
sentences.zh: 第一，我们显然对职场还很陌生，对生活也同样缺乏经验。

sentences.en: We don't really know or aren't able to express our limits, our points of exhaustion.
sentences.zh: 我们并不真正了解或者无法表达自己的极限在哪里、精疲力竭的点在哪里。

sentences.en: But secondly, I think it's because of this expectation to be doing everything, to be constantly and always aiming for more.
sentences.zh: 但其次，我认为这是因为那种必须面面俱到的期望，也就是要不断地、永远地追求更多。

sentences.en: You have to be focused at school or in your job whilst also having a lot of fulfilling friendships and then hobbies and a loving relationship and perfect physical and mental health
sentences.zh: 你必须在学校或工作上保持专注，同时还要维持许多充实的人友谊、各种爱好、一段充满爱的恋爱关系，以及完美的身体和心理健康，

sentences.en: whilst also being able to juggle your family and a side hustle and your own needs.
sentences.zh: 同时还要能够兼顾家庭、副业以及你自己的需求。

sentences.en: If that feels impossible to you, you are not the only one.
sentences.zh: 如果这对你来说听起来是不可能的任务，那么你并不是唯一这么觉得的人。

sentences.en: Each of us has an individual threshold for how much stress, activity, mental exhaustion that we can tolerate and I think as we slowly reach that threshold, we start sacrificing
sentences.zh: 我们每个人对于所能承受的压力、活动和精神疲劳都有一个各自的阈值，我认为随着我们慢慢逼近那个阈值，我们开始牺牲

sentences.en: elements of our well-being to keep up with what is expected of us and what we expect from ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们福祉的各个方面，来勉强跟上外界对我们的期望以及我们对自己的期望。

sentences.en: And that includes very tangible things like sleep, self-care, exercise, downtime.
sentences.zh: 这包括一些非常具体的事情，比如睡眠、自我关怀、锻炼和个人空闲时间。

sentences.en: Those are normally the first things to go when we're burnt out and also more intangible things like mental rest, thinking time, a space for imagination and creativity.
sentences.zh: 当我们精疲力竭时，这些通常是最先被抛弃的东西，此外还有一些更无形的东西，比如精神上的休息、思考的时间、留给想象力和创造力的空间。

sentences.en: You need all of these things to keep your spark alight.
sentences.zh: 你需要所有这些东西来维持你内心的火花不灭。

sentences.en: It's hard to prioritise the things that make you excited for life, the small joys or even the energy for the big things if you are struggling with prolonged, you know,
sentences.zh: 如果你正在经历长期以来的，你知道的，

sentences.en: prolonged exhaustion,
sentences.zh: 长期的精疲力竭，

sentences.en: prolonged fatigue,
sentences.zh: 长期的疲劳，

sentences.en: burnout from a lack of work-life balance or kind of academic or personal overload.
sentences.zh: 由于缺乏工作与生活平衡或学业、个人负担过重而导致的倦怠，想要优先顾及那些让你对生活感到兴奋的事情、小确幸，甚至是去关注大事的精力，都是很难做到的。

sentences.en: We are seeing so much of this recently and it also is demonstrating a lot of links to an increased vulnerability to illness, increased feelings of pessimism, inadequacy,
sentences.zh: 我们最近看到了太多这样的现象，这也显示出它与许多问题有着密切联系，比如更容易生病、悲观情绪增加、自我价值感低落，

sentences.en: none of which I think seem to go hand in hand with feeling like yourself or feeling like your spark is a light and alive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这些情况没有哪一个能与“做自己”或“感觉自己内心的火花明亮且充满生机”相契合。

sentences.en: So the second factor that I think contributes to losing our spark is a lingering or pre-existent mental health disorder or challenge that may be getting out of control or becoming
sentences.zh: 因此，我认为导致我们失去火花的第二个因素是挥之不去或早已存在的心理健康问题或挑战，这些问题可能正在失控，或者变得

sentences.en: a little bit unmanageable.
sentences.zh: 有点难以掌控。

sentences.en: Whether that is anxiety, depression,
sentences.zh: 无论是焦虑、抑郁、

sentences.en: ADHD, some other condition,
sentences.zh: 多动症，还是其他什么状况，

sentences.en: when it impacts our cognitions, our mood, our emotions, this condition is going to impact our so-called spark and most importantly our way of relating to the world.
sentences.zh: 当这些状况影响到我们的认知、情绪和情感时，它们就会冲击我们所谓的火花，最重要的是，会影响我们与世界建立联系的方式。

sentences.en: So many factors impact this and sometimes there really isn't an explanation for why your mental health is suddenly not as good but I don't think anyone really talks about how
sentences.zh: 有太多因素在影响着这一点，有时你的心理健康状况突然变差确实没有什么明确的解释，但我觉得没有人真正讨论过，把100%的精力都用来

sentences.en: physically tiring it is to have to put 100% of your energy into just convincing yourself to do even the smallest of tasks.
sentences.zh: 说服自己去完成哪怕是最小的任务，究竟是一件多么令人体力透支的事情。

sentences.en: I think maintaining your spark and all the activities that promote this part of you is a luxury when you're just trying to get by day by day.
sentences.zh: 我认为，当你仅仅是在勉强维持温饱、过好每一天时，维持你的火花以及所有能促进你这部分特质的活动，简直就是一种奢侈。

sentences.en: The third contributing factor I think is not spending enough time with your own thoughts or operating from a place of external validation.
sentences.zh: 我认为第三个影响因素是没有花足够的时间与自己的思绪相处，或者从外部认可中寻找行事的出发点。

sentences.en: I think when we live for others how are we really meant to pull from that internal source of meaning and passion and mission?
sentences.zh: 我想，当我们为了别人而活时，我们又怎么能真正从那种内在的意义、热情和使命感的源泉中汲取力量呢？

sentences.en: How are we meant to feel like ourselves when we are engaging in extreme people pleasing?
sentences.zh: 当我们陷入极端的讨好型人格时，我们又怎么能感觉像真正的自己呢？

sentences.en: When we do feel unnecessarily guilty for other people's emotions or feelings?
sentences.zh: 当我们为别人的情绪或感受感到不必要的内疚时？

sentences.en: When we say yes when we really want to say no?
sentences.zh: 当我们明明想说不却说好的时候？

sentences.en: When we have no social boundaries?
sentences.zh: 当我们毫无社交边界时？

sentences.en: When we take on others' opinions or try and impress people at the expense of our own mental health?
sentences.zh: 当我们为了给别人留下好印象而接受他们的观点，却以牺牲自己的心理健康为代价时？

sentences.en: If our spark is cultivated from our own internal mental energy source from being connected and attached and knowledgeable about who we are, when all of that time is devoted to
